GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat last 4l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off, held up approaching 200m, clear approaching 100m, hit line storng late # held up/unlucky
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from the 400m until passing the 250m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: slow out x 1 length . Settled Down Two Wide 8th, 10 Lengths @ 1500m. fanned wider Straightening Up all Clear Ridden Along . Just Held Ground well back (vetted - 1/5 lame off foreleg) # 1/5 lame off fore
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 450m was hampered when crowded. When questioned re performance, rdr std the gelding travelled satisfactorily in the run but was disappointing in its failure to quicken when placed under pressure passing the 700m, and in his opinion it may not have appreciated the Good track conditions. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be lame (1/5) in the off-foreleg. Stable rep was advised a vet clearance would be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back in second half Two Wide 7 Lengths 1000m, tracked into the race With Cover before the corner, peeled to Middle Of Track and let down last 200m, had a battle last 150m but got head down at right time for strong win # finished too well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was eased when tightened between runners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length sat last 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on strong making good ground # slow start costly
Bit Slow Out eased back to last 15l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home well making steady ground # back/home ok
Jumped Ok sat rail 6l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4l off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down rear 7 Lengths Not Enough Pace On to assist Ridden Along x 500m, sprint home = task, kept trying without threatening - # Inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted behind runners from the outside barrier in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3-4l off, took off 800m, half off 2 Wide b4 turn, under pressure turn and dropped out # see again
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When weakening rounding the home turn became crowded.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair settled back 8-9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off in traffic, off heels 200m well off, hit line well late once clear # has excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the home straight.
